DELL.business_readout: Current filings provide usable demand, backlog, results, margin, cash and working-capital material. The unresolved surfaces are precise order and customer counts plus AI-specific profit, cash and working-capital attribution bridges; these are not proved public-information gaps.

MU.business_readout: Current material contains HBM shipment, capacity, packaging and issuer counterevidence. More importantly, the compiled store already contains strategic customer agreement language including take-or-pay and binding multi-year volume commitments, yet none reached the 96-candidate orders or conversion union. This is an internal query and recall failure, not absent disclosure.
MU.additional_boundary: The S2 mart returns a typed conflict for net income because two different quarter-discrete periods are both labelled FY2025 Q3. The fail-closed behavior is correct, while fiscal-period identity remains an S2-owned repair.

NVDA.business_readout: Current material contains Blackwell shipment and demand commentary, capacity commitments, data-center constraints and extensive export-control counterevidence. The newest data-center revenue result exists in the compiled store but does not enter the reported-results union, proving a current-period recall and ranking defect.
NVDA.additional_boundary: Debt maturity and interest-income rows are projected under a Gross Profit and Gross Margin table title. This source-context bleed can make irrelevant numeric rows look like margin evidence and must be repaired before ranking or EvidenceDecision.

cross_case_root_causes.finding: The collective material contract treats every metric and product term as an AND obligation, but reserves capacity only by whether a metric axis and product axis exist. Some groups therefore cannot be satisfied within their own declared capacity. It also duplicates authoritative S2 numeric obligations inside narrative material completeness.
cross_case_root_causes.impact: A useful Evidence set is reported incomplete even when the relevant narrative and NumericFacts exist; partial coverage is hidden behind one false group result.
cross_case_root_causes.earliest_owner: S1 material requirement and coverage contract
cross_case_root_causes.required_disposition: Define explicit atomic, any-of and all-of topic semantics; keep S2 numeric authority separate from narrative Evidence; validate that every compiled requirement is satisfiable within its reserved capacity.

cross_case_root_causes.finding: Table objects inherit a broad record subsection as table title even when the parsed row belongs to a different table region.
cross_case_root_causes.impact: NVDA debt maturity and interest rows can be presented as gross-margin objects, polluting retrieval before any reranker runs.
cross_case_root_causes.earliest_owner: S1 source parsing and financial object compilation
cross_case_root_causes.required_disposition: Bind every metric row to a local table title, local header and table-region lineage; fail closed or demote rows whose local context cannot be proved.

cross_case_root_causes.finding: High-value current objects already present in the store do not enter a 96-object union: MU take-or-pay agreements miss the orders and conversion routes, and the newest NVDA data-center result misses reported results.
cross_case_root_causes.impact: More sources alone would not fix the missing research material; query language, temporal preference and candidate routing are losing known useful objects.
cross_case_root_causes.earliest_owner: S1 QueryFacetPlan, lexical and dense recall, temporal ranking
cross_case_root_causes.required_disposition: After object-context repair, add provider-neutral financial synonyms and explicit current-period signals, then prove the known objects enter the candidate pool without hard-coding their identities.

cross_case_root_causes.finding: MU net-income observations bind two different discrete quarters to the same FY2025 Q3 label.
cross_case_root_causes.impact: S2 correctly refuses to choose an authoritative value, but S1 readiness cannot honestly call the requested number resolved.
cross_case_root_causes.earliest_owner: S2 fiscal-period identity and NumericFact binding
cross_case_root_causes.required_disposition: Repair period-end and fiscal-quarter identity, preserve the conflict receipt, and rerun only the affected NumericFact projection.
